mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "ingestion_event" ("event_key", "topic", "partition", "msg_offset", "status", "owner", "lease_until", "attempt_count", "create_time", "update_time") VALUES (#{eventKey}, #{topic}, #{partition}, #{offset}, 'PROCESSING', #{owner}, #{leaseUntil}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT ("event_key") DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT "event_key" AS eventKey, "topic" AS topic, "partition" AS partition, "msg_offset" AS msgOffset, "status" AS status, "owner" AS owner, "lease_until" AS leaseUntil, "attempt_count" AS attemptCount FROM "ingestion_event" WHERE "event_key" = #{eventKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE "ingestion_event" SET "status" = 'PROCESSING', "owner" = #{owner}, "lease_until" = #{leaseUntil}, "attempt_count" = COALESCE("attempt_count", 0) + 1, "update_time" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "event_key" = #{eventKey} AND "status" IN ('PROCESSING', 'FAILED') AND ("status" = 'FAILED' OR "lease_until" IS NULL OR "lease_until" < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE "ingestion_event" SET "status" = #{status}, "lease_until" = NULL, "update_time" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "event_key" = #{eventKey} AND "owner" = #{owner} AND "status" = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE "ingestion_event" SET "status" = 'FAILED', "lease_until" = NULL, "update_time" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "event_key" = #{eventKey} AND "owner" = #{owner} AND "status" = 'PROCESSING'
